name: Rin Blekwell
source:
Rin came from another world for me. She got along very well with everyone girls, except my [url=https://vndb.org/c144568]mother[/url]. And I even know why. But what can I do? Maybe she will still be able to melt her ice. Her love for me is stronger than anyone else's. Also, her knowledge may be greater than her magic or [url=https://vndb.org/c153143]Miku[/url]'s magic.
